infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Allow ThereYouGo to connect to the development server on your local network.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow ThereYouGo to use your location to notify you when you arrive at a relevant place.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow ThereYouGo to detect when you arrive at a relevant store, even when the app is in the background.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow ThereYouGo to detect when you arrive at a relevant store, even when the app is in the background.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Allow ThereYouGo to use motion activity to confirm that you have arrived at a store on foot.
